compatible.note: SessionSummary.branches (master, chat worktree rows): optional and additive; an older page ignores it, and a page reading a host without it shows the row as before

SessionSummary.fixedName, optional about on Overseer history rows, optional overseer on monitor rows and history groups: all additive. An older page ignores them; it still draws, but its Overseer History rows read the fixed name in title, and its Rename gets the refusal sentence
SessionSummary.jobsRunning, optional and additive: the count of a shut-down chat's running background jobs. An older page ignores it and shows no job running marker

master: optional mcp {server, tool} on tool calls and their events, optional mcpNote on a transcript row, optional WakeInfo.extJob; all additive: an older page draws the same rows and leaves the MCP name and note out
optional WakeInfo.job and WakeInfo.endedAt on a background job's end card: additive. An older page ignores both and draws the row from its other fields

sova_pair joins the acts an Overseer permit can name (GrantableAct, §app.overseer/pairs); additive: an older page still draws the permit row and its other acts, leaving the new act's word blank in the list
